You are an expert programmer working in a language based on lambda calculus.
Your goal is to write programs that accomplish the tasks specified by the user.
This is a domain-specific language for Logo turtle graphics.

Write programs using the available functions:

logo_unit_angle :: tangle

logo_unit_line :: tlength

logo_zero_angle :: tangle

logo_zero_line :: tlength

logo_divide_angle :: tangle -> int -> tangle

logo_multiply_angle :: tangle -> int -> tangle

logo_divide_line :: tlength -> int -> tlength

logo_multiply_line :: tlength -> int -> tlength

logo_add_angles :: tangle -> tangle -> tangle

logo_subtract_angles :: tangle -> tangle -> tangle

logo_lift_pen :: (turtle -> turtle) -> turtle -> turtle

logo_move_pen_forward_rotate :: tlength -> tangle -> turtle -> turtle

logo_get_set_function_pen :: (turtle -> turtle) -> turtle -> turtle

logo_IFTY :: int

logo_epsilon_angle :: tangle

logo_epsilon_line :: tlength

logo_for_loop :: int -> (int -> turtle -> turtle) -> turtle -> turtle

0 :: int

1 :: int

2 :: int

3 :: int

4 :: int

5 :: int

create_polygon_with_rotation :: turtle -> int -> tlength -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (lambda (logo_for_loop $1 (lambda (lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate $2 (logo_divide_angle logo_unit_angle $3) $0))) $2))))
description: Creates a polygon with a specified number of sides and rotation using the turtle graphics library.

create_line_with_rotation :: turtle -> int -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate logo_zero_line (logo_divide_angle logo_unit_angle $0) $1)))
description: Creates a line with a specified length and rotation using the turtle graphics library.

move_pen_forward_with_unit_line_and_zero_angle :: turtle -> turtle
(lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate logo_unit_line logo_zero_angle $0))
description: Moves the turtle's pen forward with a unit line length and zero angle rotation.

create_polygon_with_rotated_lines :: turtle -> tangle -> int -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (lambda (logo_for_loop $0 (lambda (lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate logo_unit_line $3 $0))) $2))))
description: Creates a polygon with rotated lines using the turtle graphics library.

create_line_with_scaled_length :: turtle -> tlength -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate (logo_multiply_line $0 5) logo_epsilon_angle $1)))
description: Creates a line with a scaled length using the turtle graphics library.

move_pen_forward_with_rotated_angle_and_length :: turtle -> int -> tlength -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (lambda (logo_move_pen_forward_rotate $0 (logo_divide_angle logo_unit_angle $1) $2))))
description: Moves the turtle's pen forward with a rotated angle and specified length using the turtle graphics library.

create_line_with_rotated_pen :: int -> turtle -> (turtle -> turtle) -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (lambda (create_line_with_rotation (logo_get_set_function_pen $0 $1) $2))))
description: Creates a line with rotation using the turtle graphics library, based on the specified pen settings.

create_polygon_with_rotation_using_unit_line :: int -> turtle -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (create_polygon_with_rotation $0 $1 logo_unit_line)))
description: Creates a polygon with a specified number of sides and rotation using a unit line length

apply_function_for_loop_with_infinity :: turtle -> (turtle -> turtle) -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (logo_for_loop logo_IFTY (lambda $1) $1)))
description: Applies a function repeatedly using a for loop with infinity as the loop count

apply_function_for_loop_with_fixed_iterations :: turtle -> (turtle -> turtle) -> turtle
(lambda (lambda (logo_for_loop 9 (lambda $1) $1)))
description: Applies a given function repeatedly using a for loop with a fixed number of iterations (9 in this case)
